profiles.name: Zerodha
notes: Period returns are Modified Dietz on equity: equity P&L divided by starting market value plus time-weighted net purchases. Annualized XIRR and benchmark CAGR are shown only when capital has been invested for at least one year.

Window P&L carries shares held at the window start at their start-date close, so the chart and period table reconcile to the same figure. A window that starts before any capital was invested is measured from the first equity trade.
Zerodha Tradebook has no dated bank transfers before the 2026-10 statement. Net deployed capital is reconstructed from live cash less trade-derived cash, so it is an estimate.

profiles.name: Robinhood

optionsBook.source: data/options/US.json (recorded marks, not marked to market)

notes: Period returns are Modified Dietz on equity: equity P&L divided by starting market value plus time-weighted net purchases. Annualized XIRR and benchmark CAGR are shown only when capital has been invested for at least one year.

Window P&L carries shares held at the window start at their start-date close, so the chart and period table reconcile to the same figure. A window that starts before any capital was invested is measured from the first equity trade.

Open option contracts are valued at the marks recorded in data/options/US.json, which are not marked to market. Option P&L (premium cash plus recorded value) is included only in the All-time column because historical option values are unavailable.

The 2025-01-02 implied opening margin debit is reconciled to month-end statements. It is the account's starting value in Account XIRR, not a deposit, so profit is measured against the true starting net worth. Equity trades in the export begin in May 2026, so equity XIRR is not annualized until one year of invested capital exists.
